answer.method_summary: Prospective adaptive rule for the declared higher-is-better Growth/OrganismalFitness endpoint: use item-bound, endpoint-aligned measured evidence if available; none was available here, so invoke the generic-plausibility fallback. Require a successful per-variant receipt for both signals, rank each signal higher-is-better across the frozen candidate set, and score 0.70×ESM-2 Δlog-probability percentile + 0.30×ESM-IF1 mean-log-likelihood percentile because ESM-2 is a mutation-local WT contrast while IF1 is a secondary backbone-conditioned plausibility check. Sort descending; ties break by ESM-2, then IF1, then mutant lexically. Select exactly the first ten. A failed signal is retried and never imputed as zero; unresolved failure is a coverage failure. These are generic sequence/backbone plausibility signals, not measured assay outcomes, and may be mechanistically misaligned with organismal growth.

Candidate-specific ESM-2 masked-marginal ΔlnP (higher is more plausible) is used only to break mechanistically close ties; the ESM-IF1 reference-backbone value is non-differential across candidates. No measured assay labels are used. Generic sequence/backbone plausibility is not a measured assay outcome and is not a causal model of the TbL membrane-insertion assay, so it cannot override the endpoint-aligned mechanistic ordering.

answer.method_summary: Prospective adaptive rule: obtain one successful item-bound score_variant_fm receipt for every candidate, supplying only its variant; any missing/invalid call is retried and remains a coverage failure, never a zero. Across the complete panel, compare the descending ESM-2 mutation delta-ln-probability and ESM-IF1 backbone-conditioned mean-log-likelihood rankings. If Spearman rho is at least 0.50, population-z-standardize both signals and rank by their equal-weight mean; otherwise rank conservatively by the worse (lower) of the two within-panel percentile scores, then by their mean percentile. Here rho=0.599, so the equal-weight z-score branch applied. Higher composite is preferred, consistent with the declared endpoint direction; exact ties are broken by supplied candidate order, and the first ten are selected. These are generic sequence/backbone plausibility signals, not measured ddG_ML_float or a causal stability-assay model, and may be mechanistically misaligned with cDNA-display proteolysis.
